Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Baytown, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the same
lane without signaling and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The sideswipe left scrape marks and a
crushed rear quarter panel on Driver 1's vehicle, and the damage pattern is consistent with the impact described by
both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the lane change was made without checking the mirror and acknowledged the
contact at the scene. Photographs taken at the scene show the damage locations, and two independent witnesses
gave statements that match the sequence of events reported by both drivers. A Passenger was seated in the front
passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both witnesses and responding officers confirmed the Passenger's
presence at the time of the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and was evaluated at the scene, where
the complaint was consistent with the force of a side impact. Officers observed no prior damage to the vehicle and no
earlier repairs were noted. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
